# Spunkmeyers Pub & Grill

> Spunkmeyers Pub & Grill is a restaurant & bar serving its local area. This file gives AI assistants a clear, accurate overview of the business and its most important pages.

## What we do
- Restaurant & bar in Wadsworth, Ohio. 18 beers on tap, smash burgers, the Buck Naked outdoor bar, and every big game on screen.
- SPX American Lager is on tap: the pub's own American lager, 4.7% ABV, 16 oz pour, brewed in Medina, OH, tapped September 9, 2026. Featured on the homepage.

- Spunks Pub Crawl is the pub's free phone game: Kevin (the owner, who fronts the Buck Naked Band) runs down High Street jumping his bandmates Arene, Chris, and Bob, DJ Brian, bartender Peyton, regulars Mick, Luke, and DJ, his own drum kit, burgers, wings, and beer. Scan the QR sign at the bar or play at https://spunkmeyers.pub/pub-crawl. Top scores go on the pub leaderboard.

## Key pages
- Home: https://spunkmeyers.pub/
- Spunks Pub Crawl (phone game): https://spunkmeyers.pub/pub-crawl
